rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: SFCC Development MCP server that provides AI assistants with comprehensive access to Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud development features including log analysis, debugging, and complete SFCC API documentation querying. Built by taurgis, the implementation connects to SFCC instances via WebDAV for real-time log monitoring and includes converted documentation for all dw.* server-side classes available in the SFCC Rhino JavaScript environment, plus curated best practices guides for OCAPI hooks, SCAPI hooks, SFRA controllers, and custom endpoints. Features intelligent caching, rate limiting, and supports both basic authentication and OAuth, making it valuable for SFCC developers who want conversational access to logs, API references, and development patterns without manually navigating documentation or WebDAV interfaces.
